name: Xorphanol
summary: Xorphanol (INN; also known as xorphanol mesylate (USAN); developmental codes TR-5379 or TR-5379M) is an opioid analgesic of the morphinan family that was never marketed.

pharmacology.text: The drug has also been found to act as an agonist of the δ-opioid receptor (Ki = 1.0 nM; IC50 = 8 nM; Imax = 76%).

uses.text: Xorphanol (INN; also known as xorphanol mesylate (USAN); developmental codes TR-5379 or TR-5379M) is an opioid analgesic of the morphinan family that was never marketed. It has been encountered as a novel designer drug.
